svg.title: The transformer for the running example
svg.desc: Top: input 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4, 96 layers of attention and MLP, unembedding, output distribution with Bg4 first. Middle: the attention panel with arcs from d4 to earlier tokens and three heads; the MLP panel with features. Bottom: the embedding shift of d4 and the unembedding with Bg4, exd4, Nd7 and Nf6.
svg.text: Token looks back and adds what is relevant. Features are captured
in 96 parallel heads (per layer, numbers for GPT-3).
Head A ≈ same side, same kind
relates e4 and d4, the center pawns
relates e4 e5 Nf3 d6 d4, the Philidor

svg.title: Embedding shift across the transformer layers
svg.desc: The vector for the token "Amount" starts at its embedding. Each layer adds an attention push (a1, a2, a3, ... a96; the first one shown as the sum of three head contributions) and an MLP push (m1, m2, m3, ... m96). The final vector, "Amount + context", ends at an angle to the embedding: the semantic adjustment.

svg.text: Layer by layer, attention (a) and MLP (m) pushes move the point for d4; the pushes add up to its meaning in this game.
